call_points.text: FY27 guidance held at 20% AUM growth, 20% PAT growth and 17-18% disbursement growth.
Non-home loans at 76-24 of incremental disbursement versus historical 70-30; normalcy expected from Q3.
Management flagged West Asia geopolitical uncertainty and the monsoon outlook as the two external risks it is watching.
Exit cost of funds stood at 7.71% and exit spreads at 5.82% as of March 31, 2026.
Average ticket size stands at ₹10.9 lakhs with a 60% loan-to-value ratio.

guidance.statement: We would continue with similar guidance of 20% AUM, 20% profit and 17% to 18% disbursement growth.
Medium-term guidance of 20% AUM growth, 20% profit growth and 17-18% disbursement growth for FY27
Next three quarters targeted at disbursement growth upward of 20%
Full-year credit cost expected to settle at 23-25 bps and GNPA at about 1.1%
Cost-to-income to fall 30-40 bps a year, about 6-7 bps on cost to AUM
ROE of about 17% a couple of years down the line

entities.name: Aadhar Sales and Services Private Limited

industry: Financial Services > Finance > Housing Finance Company

operating_notes.text: GNPA 1.09%, NNPA 0.71%, provision coverage 35.68% and CRAR 42.49% as at March 31, 2026.
FY26 assignment of loans not in default: 16,145 accounts worth ₹1,580.48 Cr, with 10% MRR retained.
AUM crossed ₹30,571 Cr as of March 31, 2026, registering 20% YoY growth.
Portfolio yield exit was 13.5% in Q1FY27 with exit spread of 5.8%; urban yields are 11.5-12% versus 14-14.8% in emerging locations.
Average ticket size is ₹11 lakh with 60% loan-to-value; salaried segment is 55% of AUM and 1+ DPD is 7%.
Borrowing mix at 30 June 2026: banks 49%, NHB 24%, NCD 17%, ECB 7%, others 3%; undrawn sanctions ₹991 Cr.

events.promoter: BCP Asia II Holdco VII Pte. Ltd.

timeline.summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited rescheduled its analysts/investor call on May 5, 2026, from 18:00 to 18:15 IST to discuss FY26 financials.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹984.56 Cr (+18.2% YoY), net profit ₹310.92 Cr (+27.0% YoY).
On May 5, 2026, Aadhar Housing Finance recommended the appointment of M/s. N M Raiji & Co as Joint Statutory Auditor.
Aadhar Housing Finance Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 5, 2026, available via its investor relations website.
Aadhar Housing Finance reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹311 Cr on a 27% YoY increase, with AUM crossing ₹30,571 Cr.
On 31 July 2026 Aadhar Housing told its Q1FY27 call that AUM grew 18% YoY to ₹31,364 Cr and PAT rose 19% to ₹282 Cr, while it moved disbursement recognition to cheque clearance.
